translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Yesu ikatumovi matauna tobwawa
E kwaitala sabate Yesu isuvi ola bwala taitala Parisi kasi tokugwa, mwada bikam; e imitakavataisi matauna.
E ka, taitala tobwawa isisu omatala.
Yesu iluki tokwabitam paila Mosese la Karaiwaga deli Parisi, kawala, “Ki, ibodi Mosese la Karaiwaga bitayomovasi wa yam sabate kaina gala?”
E ikapatusi. E ikau tokwatoula, ikatumovi e iwitali matauna bila.
E iluki matausina, kawala, “Kidamwa taitala yokomi iyosi natana ase kaina bulumakau,
e kidamwa minawena bikapusi outuwotu, bogwa binanakwa bilupi minana wa yam sabate ke?”
E gala igagabila bivitakaulokaisi baisa.
Bigavisaiki paila tokula paka deli tolipaka
Tutala Yesu igisi tokula paka iyupalaisi kabosisu bwaina, iluki bigavisaiki baisa matausina.
“Kidamwa availa bidouwaim oveivai pakala, taga kusila okabosisu walakaiwa, paila kaina bogwa leidou taitala kam tokugwa;
e tolipaka bilukwaim, kawala, ‘Kusaiki m kwabosisu baisa matauna,’ e deli kam mmosila bukusibusi kabosisu watanawa.
Mitaga kidamwa bidouwaim, kula kusili watanawa; e tutala tolipaka bima, kaina bilukwaim, kawala, ‘Sogu, kuma walakaiwa,’ matutowena kam yakaula bitokaia omitasi matausina ikamkwamsi deli yoku.
Paila availa bilupi titoulela walakaiwa Yaubada bivabu watanawa; e availa bivabu titoulela, Yaubada bilupi walakaiwa.”
Tuvaila iluki tolipaka, kawala, “Tutala bukuvagi avai paka, taga bukudou samwa, budamwa, veyamwa, kaina avai guyau isisu katitaikinem; paila matausina kaina bidoumapwaimsi.
Mitaga tutala bukupaka, bukudou tonamakava, tosiekupuna, topem, tokwau,
e bukumwasawa; paila gala iyosisi avaka bimapwaimsi. Yaubada bimapwaim tutala tomitukwaibwaila bitokaiasi bimovavausi.”
Kwaiveka paka kala bigavisaiki
Tutala taitala deli matausina ikamkwamsi ilagi vavagi baisa, iluki Yesu, kawala, “Bimwasawa matauna bikamkwam ola Karaiwaga Yaubada!”
Mitaga Yesu iluki matauna, kawala, “Taitala tau ivagi kwaiveka paka, e idou bidubadu.
E, otutala kamkwam iwitali la touwata bikaikivisi matausina bogwa leidoubogwi, kawasi, ‘Kumaisi; paila vavagi komwaidona bogwa lakatubiasi.’

Mitaga komwaidosi, taitala taitala makawala, ivitouulasi ilivalasi uula si vitoki. Taitala iluki matauna, kawala, ‘Yeigu bogwa agimoli kubilatala kwabila, ibodaigu bala bagisi; anigadaim bukutugwalaigu.’
Taiyuwela ikaibiga, kawala, ‘Yeigu bogwa agimoli buluwotala bulumakau, bala bawakoli si peula minasina. Anigadaim bukutugwalaigu.’
Taitolula ikaibiga, kawala, ‘Yeigu bogwa lavai, mapaila gala igagabila bawa.’

“Touwata ikaimilavau ikamituli vavagi makwaisina baisa kala tokwaraiwaga. Matauna tolibwala igibuluwa, iluki la touwata, kawala, ‘Nani kula okedala valu kadavakaveka toyo kadakikekita, kuvakouli tonamakava, tosiekupuna, tokwau toyo topem, e bukumai.’
E la touwata ikaibiga, kawala, ‘Tomoya, m biga bogwa lavagi, mitaga ikesa kabosisu.’
Tokwaraiwaga iluki la touwata, kawala, ‘Kulokaia okadaula deli osiusiula keda, e kuvakouli tomota bisuvisi, kidamwa ulo bwala bikasewa.
Paila alukwaim, gala taitala matausina bogwa ladoubogwi bikamkoni ulo paka.’”
Avaka bibodi la toligalega Yesu
E tobobawa sainela ibokulaisi Yesu; e itovila iluki matausina, kawala,
“Kidamwa availa bimakaiagu, mitaga gala bipaiki tamala, toyo inala, toyo la kwava, toyo litula, toyo tuwala budala, toyo luleta, e tuvaila la momova, gala igagabila matauna ulo toligalega.
E availa gala bikeula kala korosi kidamwa bibokulaigu, gala igagabila matauna ulo toligalega.
“Kidamwa availa baisa yokomi mwada biulai bwala kwaiveka, ammakawala? Bikugwa bikainaga mapula, e binikoli kaina iyosi avaka bibodi kaina gala ke?
Kidamwa gala ivagi makawala, bogwa eisaili tumila, mitaga gala igagabila bivigimkulovi; e availa bigisaisi bivigaki kasi yousokana baisa matauna,
e bikaibigasi, kawasi, ‘Mm - tau matauna ivitouula biulai, mitaga gala gagabila bivigimkulovi.’
“E kidamwa taitala guyau la tokwabilia lakatuluwotala mwada bikabiliasi deli guyousola la tokwabilia lakatuluwoyu, ammakawala? Ikugwa binanamsa kaina igagabila bikalisau?
E kidamwa gala igagabila, e deli, guyousola isisu kaduwonaku, biwitali tosikwawa bikabilula e bivakota valu.
Mapaila avai tau yokomi gala bikatilavi vavagi komwaidona avaka iyosi, gala igagabila matauna ulo toligalega.
Yona gala kakamwenala
“Yona bwaina; mitaga kidamwa yona kakamwenala bitamwau, ammakawala bitavigaki biwaki makwaina?
Yona makwaina gala bipilasi pwaipwaia kaina bagula; tomota iligaiwaisi makwaina. Matauna ilagi ibodi biligimlili.”

footnotes.text: natana ase kaina bulumakau.Mimilisi buki pilabubogwa iginisi “taitala latum kaina natana bulumakau”.
